name: geyecloud-atd
description: Read-only OctoBus adapter for geyecloud-ATD threat aggregation and network log query APIs.

geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/AggregateT.name: aggregate-threat-events
geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/AggregateT.description: Aggregate threat events by severity, kill chain, attack status, or class type.

geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/GetNetwork.name: get-network-log-time-trend
geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/GetNetwork.description: Query network log count trend over time.

geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/GetNetwork.name: get-network-log-dimension-statistics
geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/GetNetwork.description: Aggregate network logs by a selected dimension.

geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/ListNetwor.name: list-network-logs
geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/ListNetwor.description: List network logs with time range, filters, sorting, and pagination.

geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/GetNetwork.name: get-network-log-detail
geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/GetNetwork.description: Get one network log detail by detail ID and timestamp.

geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/ListFileDe.name: list-file-detection-logs
geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/ListFileDe.description: List file detection logs with time range, filters, sorting, and pagination.

geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/GetFileDet.name: get-file-detection-log-detail
geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/GetFileDet.description: Get one file detection log detail by UUID and timestamp.

geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/SearchScen.name: search-scene-monitor-events
geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/SearchScen.description: Search events for one scene monitor.

geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/GetSituati.name: get-situation-overview
geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/GetSituati.description: Query common read-only situation overview dashboard sections.

geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/SearchThre.name: search-threat-events
geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/SearchThre.description: Search threat events through the advanced search API.

geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/GetThreatE.name: get-threat-event-detail
geyecloud.atd.v1.GEYECloudATD/GetThreatE.description: Get one threat event detail by UUID and optional sensor/IP filters.
